blank6_name_sec2 = | blank6_info_sec2 = | blank7_name_sec2 = | blank7_info_sec2 = | short_description = | footnotes = }} '''Don Victoriano''', officially the '''Municipality of Don Victoriano''', unofficially as '''Don Victoriano Chiongbian''' ({{langx|ceb|Lungsod sa Don Victoriano}}; {{langx|tl|Bayan ng Don Victoriano}}), is a [[municipality of the Philippines|municipality]] in the [[Philippine Province|province]] of [[Misamis Occidental]], [[Philippines]]. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 10,214 people.{{PH wikidata|population_reference}} The municipality is home to the [[Mount Malindang]] National Park. ==History== The municipality was originally created as '''Don Mariano Marcos''' by virtue of [[Batas Pambansa]] Blg. 171 which was approved on February 8, 1982. Parts of seven municipalities in [[Misamis Occidental|the province]] had been detached to be constituted into a new, distinct municipality. Those separated were [[barangay]]s in [[Tudela, Misamis Occidental|Tudela]] (3) including Tuno which was designated [[Poblacion|the seat of government]], [[Jimenez, Misamis Occidental|Jimenez]] (also 3), [[Bonifacio, Misamis Occidental|Bonifacio]] (2), [[Clarin, Misamis Occidental|Clarin]] and [[Sinacaban]] (one in each); as well as [[sitio]]s in a barangay each in [[Panaon, Misamis Occidental|Panaon]] and [[Aloran]], situated on the side of the [[Mount Malindang]] Range.{{cite web |url=https://issuances-library.senate.gov.ph/legislative%2Bissuances/Batas%20Pambansa%20171 |title=Batas Pambansa Blg. 171 |date=February 8, 1982 |website=Legislative Digital Resources |publisher=[[Senate of the Philippines]] |access-date=March 10, 2024}} A plebiscite for ratification, along with 10 more newly created [[local government in the Philippines|local entities]], was held on May 17, coinciding with [[1982 Philippine barangay elections|the barangay elections]].{{cite web |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1982/04/29/proclamation-no-2188-s-1982/ |title=Proclamation No. 2188, s. 1982 |date=April 29, 1982 |website=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |publisher=[[Government of the Philippines]] |access-date=March 6, 2024}} It was later renamed to its present-day one, as ''Don Victoriano'', through [[Republic Act]] No. 6845 on January 20, 1990.{{cite web |url=https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/7170 |title=Republic Act No. 6845, AN ACT CHANGING THE NAME OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF DON MARIANO MARCOS, PROVINCE OF MISAMIS OCCIDENTAL, TO MUNICIPALITY OF DON VICTORIANO |date=January 20, 1990 |website=Supreme Court E-Library |publisher=[[Supreme Court of the Philippines]] |access-date=March 10, 2024}} It was named in honor of a native of Jimenez who served as councilor of [[Plaridel, Misamis Occidental|Plaridel]] and eventually, the first mayor of this municipality.{{cite news |last=Oaminal |first=Clarence Paul |date=October 30, 2014 |title=William Lee Chiongbian and his citizenship |url=https://www.philstar.com/the-freeman/opinion/2014/10/30/1386112/william-lee-chiongbian-and-his-citizenship |newspaper=[[The Freeman (newspaper)|The Freeman]] |location=[[Philippines]] |access-date=March 10, 2024}} Recent documents such as on [[Commission on Elections (Philippines)|Commission on Elections]] and the [[Philippine Statistics Authority]] use ''Don Victoriano Chiongbian'' while [[Commission on Audit (Philippines)|Commission on Audit]],{{Cite web |title=Don Victoriano Executive Summary 2023 {{!}} Commission on Audit |url=https://www.coa.gov.ph/wpfd_file/don-victoriano-executive-summary-2023/ |access-date=2025-03-09 |language=en-US}} the local government and subsequent laws such as Republic Act No. 7329, 9692, 10017 use ''Don Victoriano''. On July 13, 2026, the [[Philippine Statistics Authority]] corrected the standardized official name of the municipality to ''Don Victoriano'' in the [[Philippine Standard Geographic Code]].{{cite web |url=https://psa.gov.ph/classification/psgc/node/1684083815 |title=Second Quarter 2026 PSGC Updates: Renaming of One Municipality and One Barangay, and Correction of 15 Geographic Names |date=July 13, 2026 |website=[[Philippine Statistics Authority]] |publisher=[[Philippine Statistics Authority]] |access-date=July 15, 2026}} ==Geography== ===Barangays=== Don Victoriano is politically subdivided into 11 [[barangay]]s.
